nodes.label: go build (CmdBuild)
nodes.desc: CmdBuild/runBuild orchestrates loading, compiling and linking a package tree; the go command is itself written in Go, living under src/cmd/go.

nodes.label: cmd/compile Main
nodes.desc: Main parses flags, wires escape analysis and inlining hooks, then typechecks and walks every function before handing it to the SSA backend.

nodes.label: buildssa
nodes.desc: buildssa converts the IR of a function into an SSA Func; ssacompile/compile.go declares the passes array (opt, lower, lowered cse) executed per function.

nodes.label: runtime.main + schedinit
nodes.desc: runtime.main (L152) calls schedinit (L843) to initialize the allocator, GC, timers and allp, then newproc launches the user main as g1.

nodes.label: type g struct
nodes.desc: A goroutine is this struct: stack bounds, status (_Grunnable/_Gwaiting/...), sched gobuf of registers, waiting sudog. A few KB, not an OS thread.

nodes.label: type m struct
nodes.desc: An OS thread with g0 stack, curg pointer and spinning flag; Ms run at most one G at a time and park in findRunnable when idle.

nodes.label: type p struct
nodes.desc: The scheduler context: runnext slot plus a 256-entry lock-free runq, mcache, timers, GC state. Work is never shared under a global lock first.

nodes.label: type schedt struct
nodes.desc: The global scheduler state: global runq, idle M and P lists, nmspinning counter that coordinates work-stealing wakeups.

nodes.label: newproc / newproc1
nodes.desc: newproc (L5341) allocates the g via newproc1 (L5359), copies arguments onto the new stack and marks the G runnable — the whole cost of one go statement.

nodes.label: runqput
nodes.desc: runqput (L7550) either fills P.runnext (the slot run on next schedule) or pushes to the 256-slot ring; runqputslow (L7596) spills half to the global queue.

nodes.label: schedule
nodes.desc: schedule (L4157) resets preemption state, calls findRunnable at L4186 and execute at L4252; goexit0 (L4513) cleans a finished G before the loop repeats.

nodes.label: findRunnable
nodes.desc: findRunnable (L3409) tries runnext, local runq, global runq, GC worker hand-off, netpoll, then stealWork (L3848); if all fail the M parks without a P.

nodes.label: runqget
nodes.desc: runqget (L7670) pops from the local ring with CAS retry loops; runqgrab (L7734) steals half of a victim P's queue in one batch.

nodes.label: stealWork
nodes.desc: stealWork (L3848) spins through other Ps in random order (4 passes), grabbing half a queue; also checks timers and can drain the global queue in injectglist (L4067).

nodes.label: execute
nodes.desc: execute (L3341) binds m.curg, sets _Grunning and enters the goroutine; gopreempt_m (L4383) is the cooperative preemption path back into schedule.

nodes.label: gopark
nodes.desc: gopark (L456) applies an unlockf (goparkunlock L478), drops the G to _Gwaiting and reschedules the M; the G stays parked until something completes its wait.

nodes.label: goready / ready
nodes.desc: goready (L492) calls ready (L1122), which moves the parked G back to _Grunnable, drops it on a P's queue and wakes an idle P if one exists.

nodes.label: goexit0
nodes.desc: goexit0 (L4513) drops status to _Gdead, releases the sudog list and M-P binding, then the thread returns to schedule — no thread is created or destroyed per goroutine.

nodes.label: sysmon / retake
nodes.desc: sysmon (L6550) runs without a P every 20us-10ms: retake (L6694) reclaims Ps stuck in syscalls and preempts long Gs; forcegcperiod (L6540) is 2 minutes.

nodes.label: retake
nodes.desc: retake (L6694) hands a P off to another M (handoffp L3141) when its M blocks in a syscall longer than 20us, keeping all Ps busy.

nodes.label: type hchan struct
nodes.desc: hchan (L34) is the channel: a circular buf with sendx/recvx (L42-43), recvq/sendq waitq lists (L44-45) and one lock (L54); makechan (L75) allocates buf inline.

nodes.label: chansend
nodes.desc: chansend (L168) first hands the value to a waiting receiver via send (L310) at L221-226, buffers it at L228-241, else enqueues a sudog at L265 and gopark at L275.

nodes.label: chanrecv
nodes.desc: chanrecv (L516) mirrors chansend: steal from a parked sender (sendDirect/recvDirect L384/L397), drain the buffer, or park on recvq until a sender or closechan (L406) completes it.

nodes.label: gcStart
nodes.desc: gcStart (L733) stops the world briefly to switch to _GCmark (L252) and enable the write barrier (L259); gcMarkDone (L997) ends the mark phase; phases documented at L33-72.

nodes.label: gcBgMarkWorker
nodes.desc: gcBgMarkWorker (L1766) exists per P: dedicated workers are scheduled by gcControllerState.findRunnableGCWorker (mgcpacer.go L859) so marking competes fairly with user Gs.

nodes.label: gcDrain (tricolor mark)
nodes.desc: gcDrain (L1253) pulls scan jobs from gcWork; markroot (L221) scans globals/stacks (scanstack L904), scanblock (L1493) follows pointers, greyobject (L1653) shades objects grey.

nodes.label: bgsweep
nodes.desc: bgsweep (L285) sweeps spans lazily in the background after mark termination; allocation can always sweep on demand, so a slow sweeper never blocks allocation.

nodes.label: mallocgc
nodes.desc: mallocgc (L1016) dispatches by size: mallocgcTiny (L1153) for <16B noscan, mallocgcSmallNoscan (L1309), the two scan paths (L1454/L1545), mallocgcLarge (L1638).

nodes.label: mcache.refill
nodes.desc: Each P's mcache (alloc array L48) holds one span per size class; refill (L160) gets a new span from the mcentral lists, allocLarge (L242) asks the mheap directly.

nodes.label: mheap.central
nodes.desc: mheap.central (L211) indexes numSpanClasses = NumSizeClasses<<1 (L576) scan/noscan span classes; each central list feeds the per-P mcaches above it.

nodes.label: poll_runtime_pollWait
nodes.desc: poll_runtime_pollWait (L342) parks the G in netpollblock (L548) until the fd is ready; netpollready (L494) hands readable Gs back to be run.

nodes.label: netpoll integration
nodes.desc: findRunnable calls netpoll(0) at L3516 as an optimization before stealing, and blocking netpoll at L3752 when idle — network readiness feeds the same run queues.

nodes.label: newstack
nodes.desc: newstack (L1067) doubles a small stack (stackGuard L102) and adjustframe (L701) rewrites pointers during copy; shrinkstack (L1298) halves an over-sized stack at GC time.

edges.label: go build invokes cmd/compile per package
M runs one G at a time
